name: A house with no roof
about: Four walls with windows and a door. The roof is up to you.

layers.name: Stone bottom
layers.tip: A ring of cobblestone with logs at the corners. Leave a gap in the front for the door.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Planks, with glass for the windows. Keep the door gap open.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: A full ring of planks, right over the door too.

yourTurn.say: Now give it a roof. Any roof you like!
ideas: Stairs that step up to the middle. Builder tricks shows you how.
A flat roof with a fence round it, for a roof garden.
A glass roof, so you can see the stars.
A roof of wool in your favourite colours.
